usage: max(sum of current owned-tree private commit, sum of current owned-tree working sets); historical peaks are not current use

on_pressure: Terminate only the owned job tree, retain diagnostics, then reduce residency, split or stream work, or release verified optional processes. Continue independent light work; do not retry an unchanged failure or stop the whole project.
scope: Current project checks and platform generation; existing source/operation gates, single CPU, global single heavy worker and protected applications remain. Old numerical limits are historical, superseded by the latest direct user instruction.
